description: Massachusetts Highway Traffic Volumes, 1996 is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Harvard Map Collection, US Census Bureau. This datalayer displays a point coverage for traffic monitoring stations throughout Massachusetts. Traffic counts, taken regularly at selected locations, show Route 128 to be the most heavily-traveled route in the region. The volumes are especially high on Route 3 and Interstate 95 (to the south), between Rt. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: For educational, non-commercial use only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
